en.text: A bag contains 5 red, 4 blue and 3 green balls. One ball is drawn at random. What is the probability that it is red?
en.explanation:
Total number of balls = 5 + 4 + 3 = 12.
Every ball is equally likely to be drawn, so each of the 12 outcomes carries the same weight.
Favourable outcomes (a red ball) = 5.
Probability = 5/12 = 5/12.
The denominator must be the TOTAL number of balls, not the number of colours — a slip that turns an easy mark into a lost one.

mr.text: एका पिशवीत 5 लाल, 4 निळे व 3 हिरवे चेंडू आहेत. त्यातून एक चेंडू यादृच्छिकपणे काढला. तो लाल असण्याची संभाव्यता किती?
mr.explanation:
एकूण चेंडू = 5 + 4 + 3 = 12.
प्रत्येक चेंडू निघण्याची शक्यता सारखीच असते, म्हणून 12 पैकी प्रत्येक निष्पत्तीचे वजन समान.
अनुकूल निष्पत्ती (लाल चेंडू) = 5.
संभाव्यता = 5/12 = 5/12.
छेदात एकूण चेंडूंची संख्या यावी, रंगांची संख्या नव्हे — या चुकीमुळे सोपा गुण हातचा जातो.

en.text: 3 fair coins are tossed together. What is the probability of getting exactly 2 heads?
en.explanation:
Each coin lands in one of 2 ways, so 3 coins give 2^3 = 8 equally likely outcomes.
Number of ways of getting exactly 2 heads out of 3 tosses = C(3, 2) = 3.
Probability = 3/8 = 3/8.
Use combinations rather than listing outcomes — C(n, k) counts exactly how many arrangements have k heads among n tosses.

mr.text: 3 नाणी एकत्र उडवली असता नेमकी 2 छापे येण्याची संभाव्यता किती?
mr.explanation:
प्रत्येक नाणे 2 प्रकारे पडू शकते, म्हणून 3 नाण्यांच्या 2^3 = 8 समसंभाव्य निष्पत्ती होतात.
3 नाण्यांपैकी नेमकी 2 छापे येण्याचे मार्ग = C(3, 2) = 3.
संभाव्यता = 3/8 = 3/8.
सर्व निष्पत्ती लिहीत बसण्याऐवजी संयोग वापरा — C(n, k) हे n पैकी k छापे येण्याचे मार्ग नेमके मोजते.

en.text: In how many ways can a committee of 3 men and 2 women be formed from 5 men and 4 women?
en.explanation:
A committee has no ranking inside it, so order does not matter and we use combinations.
Choosing 3 men from 5: C(5, 3) = 10 ways.
Choosing 2 women from 4: C(4, 2) = 6 ways.
Every choice of men can pair with every choice of women, so MULTIPLY: 10 × 6 = 60.
Adding the two would give 16 — addition is for "either/or" situations, multiplication for "this AND that".

mr.text: 5 पुरुष व 4 स्त्रिया यांच्यामधून 3 पुरुष व 2 स्त्रिया यांची समिती किती प्रकारे तयार करता येईल?
mr.explanation:
समितीत अंतर्गत क्रम नसतो, म्हणून क्रम महत्त्वाचा नाही व संयोग वापरतात.
5 पुरुषांपैकी 3 निवडणे: C(5, 3) = 10 प्रकारे.
4 स्त्रियांपैकी 2 निवडणे: C(4, 2) = 6 प्रकारे.
पुरुषांची प्रत्येक निवड स्त्रियांच्या प्रत्येक निवडीशी जोडली जाऊ शकते, म्हणून गुणाकार करा: 10 × 6 = 60.
बेरीज केल्यास 16 येते — बेरीज "किंवा" साठी तर गुणाकार "आणि" साठी वापरतात.

en.text: A box contains 5 good bulbs and 2 defective bulbs. 2 bulbs are drawn at random together. What is the probability that at least one of them is defective?
en.explanation:
"At least one defective" covers several cases — one defective, two defective, and so on — so counting them directly is slow. Use the complement instead.
The opposite of "at least one defective" is "none defective", i.e. all 2 bulbs are good.
Total ways to draw 2 bulbs from 7 = C(7, 2) = 21.
Ways to draw 2 good bulbs from 5 = C(5, 2) = 10.
P(none defective) = 10/21.
P(at least one defective) = 1 − 10/21 = 11/21 = 11/21.
Whenever a question says "at least one", reach for the complement first — it is almost always the shorter route.

mr.text: एका पेटीत 5 चांगले व 2 सदोष बल्ब आहेत. त्यातून एकाच वेळी 2 बल्ब यादृच्छिकपणे काढले. त्यांपैकी किमान एक सदोष असण्याची संभाव्यता किती?
mr.explanation:
"किमान एक सदोष" यात एक सदोष, दोन सदोष अशा अनेक शक्यता येतात, म्हणून त्या थेट मोजणे वेळखाऊ ठरते. त्याऐवजी पूरक घटना वापरा.
"किमान एक सदोष" याच्या उलट म्हणजे "एकही सदोष नाही", म्हणजे सर्व 2 बल्ब चांगले.
7 पैकी 2 बल्ब काढण्याचे एकूण मार्ग = C(7, 2) = 21.
5 चांगल्यांपैकी 2 काढण्याचे मार्ग = C(5, 2) = 10.
P(एकही सदोष नाही) = 10/21.
P(किमान एक सदोष) = 1 − 10/21 = 11/21 = 11/21.
प्रश्नात "किमान एक" असे शब्द दिसताच आधी पूरक घटनेचा विचार करावा — तोच जवळजवळ नेहमी सर्वात कमी वेळेचा मार्ग असतो.

en.text: Two dice are thrown together. What is the probability that the sum of the numbers on them is 5 or more?
en.explanation:
Each die can show 6 faces, so throwing two gives 6 × 6 = 36 equally likely outcomes. Treat the dice as distinguishable — (2,3) and (3,2) are separate outcomes.
Count the outcomes that add up to 5 or more: (1,4), (1,5), (1,6), (2,3), (2,4), (2,5), (2,6), (3,2) and so on.
There are 30 such outcomes in all.
Probability = favourable ÷ total = 30/36 = 5/6.
The commonest error is treating (2,3) and (3,2) as one outcome, which undercounts the numerator.

mr.text: दोन फासे एकत्र टाकले असता त्यांवरील संख्यांची बेरीज 5 किंवा त्याहून अधिक येण्याची संभाव्यता किती?
mr.explanation:
प्रत्येक फाशावर 6 बाजू असतात, म्हणून दोन फासे टाकल्यास 6 × 6 = 36 समसंभाव्य निष्पत्ती मिळतात. दोन्ही फासे वेगळे मानावेत — (2,3) व (3,2) या स्वतंत्र निष्पत्ती आहेत.
ज्यांची बेरीज 5 किंवा अधिक येते अशा निष्पत्ती मोजा: (1,4), (1,5), (1,6), (2,3), (2,4), (2,5), (2,6), (3,2) वगैरे.
अशा एकूण 30 निष्पत्ती आहेत.
संभाव्यता = अनुकूल ÷ एकूण = 30/36 = 5/6.
(2,3) व (3,2) एकच मानणे ही नेहमीची चूक असून त्यामुळे अंश कमी मोजला जातो.

en.text: A bag contains 5 red, 2 blue and 4 green balls. Two balls are drawn at random together. What is the probability that both are red?
en.explanation:
Total number of balls = 11.
Drawing two balls together means order does not matter, so use combinations.
Total ways to choose any 2 balls = C(11, 2) = (11 × 10)/2 = 55.
Ways to choose 2 red balls out of 5 = C(5, 2) = (5 × 4)/2 = 10.
Probability = 10/55 = 2/11.
Because the balls are drawn together (without replacement), the second draw has one fewer ball available — that is why it is 5 × 4 and not 5 × 5.

"किमान एक सदोष" यात एक सदोष, दोन सदोष अशा अनेक शक्यता येतात, म्हणून त्या थेट मोजणे वेळखाऊ ठरते. त्याऐवजी पूरक घटना वापरा.
"किमान एक सदोष" याच्या उलट म्हणजे "एकही सदोष नाही", म्हणजे सर्व 2 बल्ब चांगले.
9 पैकी 2 बल्ब काढण्याचे एकूण मार्ग = C(9, 2) = 36.
5 चांगल्यांपैकी 2 काढण्याचे मार्ग = C(5, 2) = 10.
P(एकही सदोष नाही) = 10/36.
P(किमान एक सदोष) = 1 − 10/36 = 26/36 = 13/18.
प्रश्नात "किमान एक" असे शब्द दिसताच आधी पूरक घटनेचा विचार करावा — तोच जवळजवळ नेहमी सर्वात कमी वेळेचा मार्ग असतो.

en.text: A bag contains 6 red, 2 blue and 4 green balls. Two balls are drawn at random together. What is the probability that both are red?
en.explanation:
Total number of balls = 12.
Drawing two balls together means order does not matter, so use combinations.
Total ways to choose any 2 balls = C(12, 2) = (12 × 11)/2 = 66.
Ways to choose 2 red balls out of 6 = C(6, 2) = (6 × 5)/2 = 15.
Probability = 15/66 = 5/22.
Because the balls are drawn together (without replacement), the second draw has one fewer ball available — that is why it is 6 × 5 and not 6 × 6.

mr.text: एका पिशवीत 6 लाल, 2 निळे व 4 हिरवे चेंडू आहेत. त्यातून एकाच वेळी दोन चेंडू यादृच्छिकपणे काढले. दोन्ही लाल असण्याची संभाव्यता किती?
mr.explanation:
एकूण चेंडू = 12.
दोन चेंडू एकाच वेळी काढल्याने क्रम महत्त्वाचा नाही, म्हणून संयोग (combinations) वापरा.
कोणतेही 2 चेंडू निवडण्याचे एकूण मार्ग = C(12, 2) = (12 × 11)/2 = 66.
6 लाल चेंडूंपैकी 2 निवडण्याचे मार्ग = C(6, 2) = (6 × 5)/2 = 15.
संभाव्यता = 15/66 = 5/22.
चेंडू एकत्र काढले जात असल्याने (पुन्हा न ठेवता) दुसऱ्या वेळी एक चेंडू कमी उपलब्ध असतो — म्हणूनच 6 × 5 येते, 6 × 6 नाही.

en.text: 4 fair coins are tossed together. What is the probability of getting at least 1 heads?
en.explanation:
Each coin lands in one of 2 ways, so 4 coins give 2^4 = 16 equally likely outcomes.
"At least 1" means 1 or more, so add the counts: C(4, 1) = 4 plus C(4, 2) = 6 plus C(4, 3) = 4 plus C(4, 4) = 1, giving 15 in all.
Probability = 15/16 = 15/16.
Use combinations rather than listing outcomes — C(n, k) counts exactly how many arrangements have k heads among n tosses.

mr.text: 4 नाणी एकत्र उडवली असता किमान 1 छापे येण्याची संभाव्यता किती?
mr.explanation:
प्रत्येक नाणे 2 प्रकारे पडू शकते, म्हणून 4 नाण्यांच्या 2^4 = 16 समसंभाव्य निष्पत्ती होतात.
"किमान 1" म्हणजे 1 किंवा अधिक, म्हणून बेरीज करा: C(4, 1) = 4 अधिक C(4, 2) = 6 अधिक C(4, 3) = 4 अधिक C(4, 4) = 1, एकूण 15.
संभाव्यता = 15/16 = 15/16.
सर्व निष्पत्ती लिहीत बसण्याऐवजी संयोग वापरा — C(n, k) हे n पैकी k छापे येण्याचे मार्ग नेमके मोजते.

en.text: In how many ways can a committee of 3 men and 1 woman be formed from 6 men and 3 women?
en.explanation:
A committee has no ranking inside it, so order does not matter and we use combinations.
Choosing 3 men from 6: C(6, 3) = 20 ways.
Choosing 1 woman from 3: C(3, 1) = 3 ways.
Every choice of men can pair with every choice of women, so MULTIPLY: 20 × 3 = 60.
Adding the two would give 23 — addition is for "either/or" situations, multiplication for "this AND that".

6 पुरुषांपैकी 3 निवडणे: C(6, 3) = 20 प्रकारे.
3 स्त्रियांपैकी 1 निवडणे: C(3, 1) = 3 प्रकारे.
पुरुषांची प्रत्येक निवड स्त्रियांच्या प्रत्येक निवडीशी जोडली जाऊ शकते, म्हणून गुणाकार करा: 20 × 3 = 60.
बेरीज केल्यास 23 येते — बेरीज "किंवा" साठी तर गुणाकार "आणि" साठी वापरतात.

en.text: A box contains 4 good bulbs and 2 defective bulbs. 2 bulbs are drawn at random together. What is the probability that at least one of them is defective?
en.explanation:
"At least one defective" covers several cases — one defective, two defective, and so on — so counting them directly is slow. Use the complement instead.
The opposite of "at least one defective" is "none defective", i.e. all 2 bulbs are good.
Total ways to draw 2 bulbs from 6 = C(6, 2) = 15.
Ways to draw 2 good bulbs from 4 = C(4, 2) = 6.
P(none defective) = 6/15.
P(at least one defective) = 1 − 6/15 = 9/15 = 3/5.
Whenever a question says "at least one", reach for the complement first — it is almost always the shorter route.

en.text: A bag contains 6 red, 4 blue and 3 green balls. One ball is drawn at random. What is the probability that it is red?

Total number of balls = 6 + 4 + 3 = 13.
Every ball is equally likely to be drawn, so each of the 13 outcomes carries the same weight.
Favourable outcomes (a red ball) = 6.
Probability = 6/13 = 6/13.
The denominator must be the TOTAL number of balls, not the number of colours — a slip that turns an easy mark into a lost one.

en.text: Find the mean of the following data: 6, 6, 9, 12, 17.
en.explanation:
The mean is the total divided by how many values there are: (6 + 6 + 9 + 12 + 17) ÷ 5 = 50 ÷ 5 = 10.
So the mean is 10.
For reference, this data set has a mean of 10, a median of 9 and a mode of 6 — read the question carefully, because all three are offered as options.

प्रत्येक नाणे 2 प्रकारे पडू शकते, म्हणून 3 नाण्यांच्या 2^3 = 8 समसंभाव्य निष्पत्ती होतात.
"किमान 1" म्हणजे 1 किंवा अधिक, म्हणून बेरीज करा: C(3, 1) = 3 अधिक C(3, 2) = 3 अधिक C(3, 3) = 1, एकूण 7.
संभाव्यता = 7/8 = 7/8.
सर्व निष्पत्ती लिहीत बसण्याऐवजी संयोग वापरा — C(n, k) हे n पैकी k छापे येण्याचे मार्ग नेमके मोजते.

en.text: In how many ways can a committee of 3 men and 2 women be formed from 8 men and 4 women?
en.explanation:
A committee has no ranking inside it, so order does not matter and we use combinations.
Choosing 3 men from 8: C(8, 3) = 56 ways.
Choosing 2 women from 4: C(4, 2) = 6 ways.
Every choice of men can pair with every choice of women, so MULTIPLY: 56 × 6 = 336.
Adding the two would give 62 — addition is for "either/or" situations, multiplication for "this AND that".

mr.text: 8 पुरुष व 4 स्त्रिया यांच्यामधून 3 पुरुष व 2 स्त्रिया यांची समिती किती प्रकारे तयार करता येईल?
mr.explanation:
समितीत अंतर्गत क्रम नसतो, म्हणून क्रम महत्त्वाचा नाही व संयोग वापरतात.
8 पुरुषांपैकी 3 निवडणे: C(8, 3) = 56 प्रकारे.
4 स्त्रियांपैकी 2 निवडणे: C(4, 2) = 6 प्रकारे.
पुरुषांची प्रत्येक निवड स्त्रियांच्या प्रत्येक निवडीशी जोडली जाऊ शकते, म्हणून गुणाकार करा: 56 × 6 = 336.
बेरीज केल्यास 62 येते — बेरीज "किंवा" साठी तर गुणाकार "आणि" साठी वापरतात.

en.text: A box contains 6 good bulbs and 3 defective bulbs. 3 bulbs are drawn at random together. What is the probability that at least one of them is defective?
en.explanation:
"At least one defective" covers several cases — one defective, two defective, and so on — so counting them directly is slow. Use the complement instead.
The opposite of "at least one defective" is "none defective", i.e. all 3 bulbs are good.
Total ways to draw 3 bulbs from 9 = C(9, 3) = 84.
Ways to draw 3 good bulbs from 6 = C(6, 3) = 20.
P(none defective) = 20/84.
P(at least one defective) = 1 − 20/84 = 64/84 = 16/21.
Whenever a question says "at least one", reach for the complement first — it is almost always the shorter route.

mr.text: एका पेटीत 6 चांगले व 3 सदोष बल्ब आहेत. त्यातून एकाच वेळी 3 बल्ब यादृच्छिकपणे काढले. त्यांपैकी किमान एक सदोष असण्याची संभाव्यता किती?
mr.explanation:
"किमान एक सदोष" यात एक सदोष, दोन सदोष अशा अनेक शक्यता येतात, म्हणून त्या थेट मोजणे वेळखाऊ ठरते. त्याऐवजी पूरक घटना वापरा.
"किमान एक सदोष" याच्या उलट म्हणजे "एकही सदोष नाही", म्हणजे सर्व 3 बल्ब चांगले.
9 पैकी 3 बल्ब काढण्याचे एकूण मार्ग = C(9, 3) = 84.
6 चांगल्यांपैकी 3 काढण्याचे मार्ग = C(6, 3) = 20.
P(एकही सदोष नाही) = 20/84.
P(किमान एक सदोष) = 1 − 20/84 = 64/84 = 16/21.
प्रश्नात "किमान एक" असे शब्द दिसताच आधी पूरक घटनेचा विचार करावा — तोच जवळजवळ नेहमी सर्वात कमी वेळेचा मार्ग असतो.

en.text: A bag contains 3 red, 4 blue and 3 green balls. Two balls are drawn at random together. What is the probability that both are red?
en.explanation:
Total number of balls = 10.
Drawing two balls together means order does not matter, so use combinations.
Total ways to choose any 2 balls = C(10, 2) = (10 × 9)/2 = 45.
Ways to choose 2 red balls out of 3 = C(3, 2) = (3 × 2)/2 = 3.
Probability = 3/45 = 1/15.
Because the balls are drawn together (without replacement), the second draw has one fewer ball available — that is why it is 3 × 2 and not 3 × 3.

mr.text: एका पिशवीत 3 लाल, 4 निळे व 3 हिरवे चेंडू आहेत. त्यातून एकाच वेळी दोन चेंडू यादृच्छिकपणे काढले. दोन्ही लाल असण्याची संभाव्यता किती?
mr.explanation:
एकूण चेंडू = 10.
दोन चेंडू एकाच वेळी काढल्याने क्रम महत्त्वाचा नाही, म्हणून संयोग (combinations) वापरा.
कोणतेही 2 चेंडू निवडण्याचे एकूण मार्ग = C(10, 2) = (10 × 9)/2 = 45.
3 लाल चेंडूंपैकी 2 निवडण्याचे मार्ग = C(3, 2) = (3 × 2)/2 = 3.
संभाव्यता = 3/45 = 1/15.
चेंडू एकत्र काढले जात असल्याने (पुन्हा न ठेवता) दुसऱ्या वेळी एक चेंडू कमी उपलब्ध असतो — म्हणूनच 3 × 2 येते, 3 × 3 नाही.

en.text: 5 fair coins are tossed together. What is the probability of getting exactly 2 heads?
en.explanation:
Each coin lands in one of 2 ways, so 5 coins give 2^5 = 32 equally likely outcomes.
Number of ways of getting exactly 2 heads out of 5 tosses = C(5, 2) = 10.
Probability = 10/32 = 5/16.
Use combinations rather than listing outcomes — C(n, k) counts exactly how many arrangements have k heads among n tosses.

mr.text: 5 नाणी एकत्र उडवली असता नेमकी 2 छापे येण्याची संभाव्यता किती?
mr.explanation:

en.text: 2 fair coins are tossed together. What is the probability of getting exactly 0 heads?

mr.text: 2 नाणी एकत्र उडवली असता नेमकी 0 छापे येण्याची संभाव्यता किती?

en.text: A bag contains 6 red, 2 blue and 3 green balls. One ball is drawn at random. What is the probability that it is red?
en.explanation:
Total number of balls = 6 + 2 + 3 = 11.
Every ball is equally likely to be drawn, so each of the 11 outcomes carries the same weight.
Favourable outcomes (a red ball) = 6.
Probability = 6/11 = 6/11.
The denominator must be the TOTAL number of balls, not the number of colours — a slip that turns an easy mark into a lost one.

mr.text: एका पिशवीत 6 लाल, 2 निळे व 3 हिरवे चेंडू आहेत. त्यातून एक चेंडू यादृच्छिकपणे काढला. तो लाल असण्याची संभाव्यता किती?
mr.explanation:
एकूण चेंडू = 6 + 2 + 3 = 11.
प्रत्येक चेंडू निघण्याची शक्यता सारखीच असते, म्हणून 11 पैकी प्रत्येक निष्पत्तीचे वजन समान.
अनुकूल निष्पत्ती (लाल चेंडू) = 6.
संभाव्यता = 6/11 = 6/11.
छेदात एकूण चेंडूंची संख्या यावी, रंगांची संख्या नव्हे — या चुकीमुळे सोपा गुण हातचा जातो.

en.text: 4 fair coins are tossed together. What is the probability of getting at least 3 heads?
en.explanation:
Each coin lands in one of 2 ways, so 4 coins give 2^4 = 16 equally likely outcomes.
"At least 3" means 3 or more, so add the counts: C(4, 3) = 4 plus C(4, 4) = 1, giving 5 in all.
Probability = 5/16 = 5/16.
Use combinations rather than listing outcomes — C(n, k) counts exactly how many arrangements have k heads among n tosses.

mr.text: 4 नाणी एकत्र उडवली असता किमान 3 छापे येण्याची संभाव्यता किती?
mr.explanation:

"किमान 3" म्हणजे 3 किंवा अधिक, म्हणून बेरीज करा: C(4, 3) = 4 अधिक C(4, 4) = 1, एकूण 5.
संभाव्यता = 5/16 = 5/16.
सर्व निष्पत्ती लिहीत बसण्याऐवजी संयोग वापरा — C(n, k) हे n पैकी k छापे येण्याचे मार्ग नेमके मोजते.

en.text: A bag contains 5 red, 3 blue and 4 green balls. Two balls are drawn at random together. What is the probability that both are red?

mr.text: एका पिशवीत 5 लाल, 3 निळे व 4 हिरवे चेंडू आहेत. त्यातून एकाच वेळी दोन चेंडू यादृच्छिकपणे काढले. दोन्ही लाल असण्याची संभाव्यता किती?

en.text: Find the next term in the series: 4, 13, 22, 31, 40, ?
en.explanation:
Start by taking the differences between consecutive terms.
13 − 4 = 9, 22 − 13 = 9, 31 − 22 = 9, 40 − 31 = 9.
The difference is constant at 9, so this is an arithmetic series.
The next term = 40 + 9 = 49.
Always compute the differences first — if they come out constant, the series is settled in seconds and you can move on.

mr.explanation:
प्रथम लागोपाठच्या पदांतील फरक काढा.
13 − 4 = 9, 22 − 13 = 9, 31 − 22 = 9, 40 − 31 = 9.
फरक सर्वत्र 9 असा स्थिर आहे, म्हणून ही अंकगणिती श्रेणी आहे.
पुढचे पद = 40 + 9 = 49.
नेहमी आधी फरक काढावेत — ते स्थिर आले की श्रेणी क्षणात सुटते आणि वेळ वाचतो.

en.text: Find the next term in the series: 8, 24, 72, 216, 648, ?
en.explanation:
The differences here are not constant, so try dividing each term by the one before it.
24 ÷ 8 = 3, 72 ÷ 24 = 3, 216 ÷ 72 = 3, 648 ÷ 216 = 3.
The ratio is constant at 3, so this is a geometric series.
The next term = 648 × 3 = 1944.
When the terms grow quickly, check ratios before differences — that ordering saves time.

mr.explanation:
येथे फरक स्थिर नाहीत, म्हणून प्रत्येक पदाला त्याच्या आधीच्या पदाने भागून पाहा.
24 ÷ 8 = 3, 72 ÷ 24 = 3, 216 ÷ 72 = 3, 648 ÷ 216 = 3.
गुणोत्तर सर्वत्र 3 असे स्थिर आहे, म्हणून ही भूमिती श्रेणी आहे.
पुढचे पद = 648 × 3 = 1944.
पदे झपाट्याने वाढत असतील तर आधी गुणोत्तर तपासावे, नंतर फरक — या क्रमाने वेळ वाचतो.

en.text: Find the next term in the series: 5, 7, 13, 23, 37, ?
en.explanation:
The differences between consecutive terms are 2, 6, 10, 14 — not constant, so look one level deeper.
The differences OF those differences are 4, 4, 4 — constant.
So the gaps themselves grow by 4 each time.
The next gap = 14 + 4 = 18.
The next term = 37 + 18 = 55.
When the first differences are not constant, take the second differences before abandoning the idea — a great many exam series are of exactly this type.

mr.explanation:
लागोपाठच्या पदांतील फरक 2, 6, 10, 14 असे आहेत — ते स्थिर नाहीत, म्हणून आणखी एक पायरी खोल पाहा.
या फरकांचे फरक 4, 4, 4 असे स्थिर आहेत.
म्हणजे प्रत्येक वेळी अंतर 4 ने वाढते.

Start by taking the differences between consecutive terms.
35 − 23 = 12, 47 − 35 = 12, 59 − 47 = 12, 71 − 59 = 12.
The difference is constant at 12, so this is an arithmetic series.
The next term = 71 + 12 = 83.
Always compute the differences first — if they come out constant, the series is settled in seconds and you can move on.

प्रथम लागोपाठच्या पदांतील फरक काढा.
35 − 23 = 12, 47 − 35 = 12, 59 − 47 = 12, 71 − 59 = 12.
फरक सर्वत्र 12 असा स्थिर आहे, म्हणून ही अंकगणिती श्रेणी आहे.
पुढचे पद = 71 + 12 = 83.
नेहमी आधी फरक काढावेत — ते स्थिर आले की श्रेणी क्षणात सुटते आणि वेळ वाचतो.

en.text: Find the next term in the series: 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, ?
en.explanation:
The differences here are not constant, so try dividing each term by the one before it.
8 ÷ 4 = 2, 16 ÷ 8 = 2, 32 ÷ 16 = 2, 64 ÷ 32 = 2.
The ratio is constant at 2, so this is a geometric series.
The next term = 64 × 2 = 128.
When the terms grow quickly, check ratios before differences — that ordering saves time.

8 ÷ 4 = 2, 16 ÷ 8 = 2, 32 ÷ 16 = 2, 64 ÷ 32 = 2.
गुणोत्तर सर्वत्र 2 असे स्थिर आहे, म्हणून ही भूमिती श्रेणी आहे.
पुढचे पद = 64 × 2 = 128.
पदे झपाट्याने वाढत असतील तर आधी गुणोत्तर तपासावे, नंतर फरक — या क्रमाने वेळ वाचतो.

en.text: Find the next term in the series: 2, 9, 23, 51, 107, ?

en.text: Find the next term in the series: 2, 7, 9, 16, 25, 41, ?

7 + 9 = 16 ✓
9 + 16 = 25 ✓
16 + 25 = 41 ✓
Every term is the sum of the two terms immediately before it — a Fibonacci-style pattern.
The next term = 25 + 41 = 66.
Whenever the ratios of a series creep slowly towards about 1.6, suspect this pattern straight away.

en.text: Find the next term in the series: 3, 6, 9, 16, 15, 26, ?
en.explanation:

The missing term sits in the 7th position, so it belongs to the FIRST series.
It follows 15, so it equals 15 + 6 = 21.
When a series zig-zags, always try separating the odd-numbered and even-numbered positions before anything else.

पदे अनियमितपणे वरखाली होत आहेत, हे दोन श्रेणी एकमेकांत गुंफल्याचे लक्षण आहे. स्थानानुसार त्या वेगळ्या करा.

ते 15 नंतर येते, म्हणून ते 15 + 6 = 21 इतके आहे.

mr.text: एका सांकेतिक भाषेत YELLOW हा शब्द ZDMKPV असा लिहितात. तर त्याच संकेतानुसार MARKET हा शब्द कसा लिहिला जाईल?

en.text: In a certain code language, NUMBER is written as KRJYBO. How will WONDER be written in the same code?

en.text: In a certain code language, TEMPLE is written as GVNKOV. How will SILVER be written in the same code?

T → G, E → V, M → N, P → K, L → O, E → V.
Each letter has been replaced by its OPPOSITE in the alphabet: A pairs with Z, B with Y, C with X and so on. The two positions in any pair always add up to 27.
Now apply exactly the same rule to SILVER:
S → H, I → R, L → O, V → E, E → V, R → I.

en.text: A man starts from point P, faces east, and walks 13 km. He then turns to his right and walks 15 km. He then turns to his right and walks 5 km. How far, in km, is he now from point P in a straight line?
en.explanation:
Track the two directions separately rather than trying to picture the whole path at once.
He first walks 13 km, then after two right turns the last leg of 5 km takes him back along the same axis, so his net travel on that axis is 13 − 5 = 8 km.
On the other axis he has moved 15 km, and nothing cancels it.
So he is 8 km away in one direction and 15 km in a perpendicular direction — the straight-line distance is the hypotenuse of a right triangle.
Distance = √(8² + 15²) = √(64 + 225) = √289 = 17 km.
The total distance WALKED is 33 km, but the question asks for the straight-line gap, which is always smaller.

प हे ठिकाण आरंभबिंदू धरा आणि उत्तर वर, पूर्व उजवीकडे असे मानून आकृती काढा.
पहिल्या 6 किमीच्या टप्प्यात तो पूर्व दिशेने 6 किमी जातो.
उजवीकडे वळल्यानंतर दुसऱ्या 3 किमीच्या टप्प्यात तो दुसऱ्या अक्षावर सरकतो.
दोन्ही टप्पे मिळून तो प पासून 3 किमी दक्षिणेला व 6 किमी पूर्वेला पोहोचतो.
एखादा बिंदू दक्षिणेला व पूर्वेला अशा दोन्ही बाजूंना असेल, तेव्हा त्याची दिशा आग्नेय असते.
प्रश्नात तो प च्या सापेक्ष कोठे आहे असे विचारले आहे, प तो कोठे आहे असे नाही — या दोन दिशा नेमक्या विरुद्ध असतात आणि त्यांची गल्लत होणे ही नेहमीची चूक आहे.

en.text: A man starts from point P, faces north, and walks 14 km. He then turns to his right and walks 16 km. He then turns to his right and walks 2 km. How far, in km, is he now from point P in a straight line?
en.explanation:
Track the two directions separately rather than trying to picture the whole path at once.
He first walks 14 km, then after two right turns the last leg of 2 km takes him back along the same axis, so his net travel on that axis is 14 − 2 = 12 km.
On the other axis he has moved 16 km, and nothing cancels it.
So he is 12 km away in one direction and 16 km in a perpendicular direction — the straight-line distance is the hypotenuse of a right triangle.
Distance = √(12² + 16²) = √(144 + 256) = √400 = 20 km.
The total distance WALKED is 32 km, but the question asks for the straight-line gap, which is always smaller.

दुसऱ्या अक्षावर तो 16 किमी सरकला असून ते कशानेही रद्द होत नाही.
म्हणजे तो एका दिशेने 12 किमी व त्याला लंब दिशेने 16 किमी अंतरावर आहे — सरळ रेषेतील अंतर म्हणजे काटकोन त्रिकोणाचा कर्ण.

en.text: A man starts from point P, faces east, and walks 5 km. He then turns to his right and walks 3 km. He then turns to his right and walks 6 km. He then turns to his right and walks 4 km. In which direction is he facing now?
en.explanation:
The distances are irrelevant here — only the turns change the direction he faces.
Start the compass at east.
Turning to his right from east makes him face south.
Turning to his right from south makes him face west.
Turning to his right from west makes him face north.
So he is finally facing north.
Keep in mind that left and right are from the WALKER's point of view, so a right turn always moves the compass one quarter clockwise: north to east to south to west.

en.text: A man starts from point P, faces west, and walks 8 km. He then turns to his right and walks 7 km. In which direction is he now from point P?

Put point P at the origin and treat north as up and east as right.
His first leg of 8 km takes him 8 km west along the east-west axis.
After turning to his right he is facing north, and the second leg of 7 km moves him along the other axis.

When a point lies both to the north and to the west, its direction is north-west.
The question asks where HE is relative to P, not where P is relative to him — those two are exact opposites, and mixing them up is the classic error.

येथे अंतरे बिनमहत्त्वाची आहेत — फक्त वळणांमुळेच तोंडाची दिशा बदलते.
सुरुवातीला तोंड उत्तर दिशेला.
उत्तर कडून डावीकडे वळल्यावर तोंड पश्चिम दिशेला होते.
पश्चिम कडून डावीकडे वळल्यावर तोंड दक्षिण दिशेला होते.
दक्षिण कडून उजवीकडे वळल्यावर तोंड पश्चिम दिशेला होते.
म्हणून शेवटी त्याचे तोंड पश्चिम दिशेला आहे.
डावे-उजवे हे चालणाऱ्याच्या दृष्टिकोनातून असते हे लक्षात ठेवा, म्हणून उजवे वळण होकायंत्र नेहमी एक चतुर्थांश घड्याळाच्या दिशेने फिरवते: उत्तर ते पूर्व ते दक्षिण ते पश्चिम.

en.text: A man starts from point P, faces north, and walks 10 km. He then turns to his left and walks 3 km. In which direction is he now from point P?
en.explanation:
Put point P at the origin and treat north as up and east as right.
His first leg of 10 km takes him 10 km north along the north-south axis.
After turning to his left he is facing west, and the second leg of 3 km moves him along the other axis.
Adding the two legs, he ends up 10 km to the north and 3 km to the west of P.
When a point lies both to the north and to the west, its direction is north-west.
The question asks where HE is relative to P, not where P is relative to him — those two are exact opposites, and mixing them up is the classic error.

mr.text: एक माणूस प या ठिकाणाहून उत्तर दिशेला तोंड करून 10 किमी चालतो. नंतर तो आपल्या डाव्या बाजूला वळून 3 किमी चालतो. तर आता तो प या ठिकाणापासून कोणत्या दिशेला आहे?
mr.explanation:
प हे ठिकाण आरंभबिंदू धरा आणि उत्तर वर, पूर्व उजवीकडे असे मानून आकृती काढा.
पहिल्या 10 किमीच्या टप्प्यात तो उत्तर दिशेने 10 किमी जातो.
डावीकडे वळल्यानंतर दुसऱ्या 3 किमीच्या टप्प्यात तो दुसऱ्या अक्षावर सरकतो.
दोन्ही टप्पे मिळून तो प पासून 10 किमी उत्तरेला व 3 किमी पश्चिमेला पोहोचतो.
एखादा बिंदू उत्तरेला व पश्चिमेला अशा दोन्ही बाजूंना असेल, तेव्हा त्याची दिशा वायव्य असते.
प्रश्नात तो प च्या सापेक्ष कोठे आहे असे विचारले आहे, प तो कोठे आहे असे नाही — या दोन दिशा नेमक्या विरुद्ध असतात आणि त्यांची गल्लत होणे ही नेहमीची चूक आहे.

en.text: A man starts from point P, faces south, and walks 8 km. He then turns to his right and walks 4 km. He then turns to his right and walks 5 km. How far, in km, is he now from point P in a straight line?
en.explanation:
Track the two directions separately rather than trying to picture the whole path at once.
He first walks 8 km, then after two right turns the last leg of 5 km takes him back along the same axis, so his net travel on that axis is 8 − 5 = 3 km.
On the other axis he has moved 4 km, and nothing cancels it.
So he is 3 km away in one direction and 4 km in a perpendicular direction — the straight-line distance is the hypotenuse of a right triangle.
Distance = √(3² + 4²) = √(9 + 16) = √25 = 5 km.
The total distance WALKED is 17 km, but the question asks for the straight-line gap, which is always smaller.

संपूर्ण मार्ग एकदम डोळ्यासमोर आणण्यापेक्षा दोन्ही दिशा स्वतंत्रपणे मोजा.
तो प्रथम 8 किमी चालतो, नंतर दोन उजव्या वळणांनंतरचा 3 किमीचा शेवटचा टप्पा त्याला त्याच अक्षावर मागे आणतो, म्हणून त्या अक्षावरील निव्वळ प्रवास 8 − 3 = 5 किमी.
दुसऱ्या अक्षावर तो 12 किमी सरकला असून ते कशानेही रद्द होत नाही.
म्हणजे तो एका दिशेने 5 किमी व त्याला लंब दिशेने 12 किमी अंतरावर आहे — सरळ रेषेतील अंतर म्हणजे काटकोन त्रिकोणाचा कर्ण.
अंतर = √(5² + 12²) = √(25 + 144) = √169 = 13 किमी.
प्रत्यक्ष चाललेले एकूण अंतर 23 किमी आहे, पण प्रश्नात सरळ रेषेतील अंतर विचारले असून ते नेहमी कमीच असते.

en.text: A man starts from point P, faces west, and walks 5 km. He then turns to his right and walks 3 km. He then turns to his right and walks 6 km. He then turns to his left and walks 4 km. In which direction is he facing now?
en.explanation:
The distances are irrelevant here — only the turns change the direction he faces.
Start the compass at west.
Turning to his right from west makes him face north.
Turning to his right from north makes him face east.
Turning to his left from east makes him face north.
So he is finally facing north.
Keep in mind that left and right are from the WALKER's point of view, so a right turn always moves the compass one quarter clockwise: north to east to south to west.

mr.text: एक माणूस प या ठिकाणाहून पश्चिम दिशेला तोंड करून 5 किमी चालतो. नंतर तो आपल्या उजव्या बाजूला वळून 3 किमी चालतो. नंतर तो आपल्या उजव्या बाजूला वळून 6 किमी चालतो. नंतर तो आपल्या डाव्या बाजूला वळून 4 किमी चालतो. तर आता त्याचे तोंड कोणत्या दिशेला आहे?
mr.explanation:
येथे अंतरे बिनमहत्त्वाची आहेत — फक्त वळणांमुळेच तोंडाची दिशा बदलते.
सुरुवातीला तोंड पश्चिम दिशेला.
पश्चिम कडून उजवीकडे वळल्यावर तोंड उत्तर दिशेला होते.
उत्तर कडून उजवीकडे वळल्यावर तोंड पूर्व दिशेला होते.
पूर्व कडून डावीकडे वळल्यावर तोंड उत्तर दिशेला होते.
म्हणून शेवटी त्याचे तोंड उत्तर दिशेला आहे.
डावे-उजवे हे चालणाऱ्याच्या दृष्टिकोनातून असते हे लक्षात ठेवा, म्हणून उजवे वळण होकायंत्र नेहमी एक चतुर्थांश घड्याळाच्या दिशेने फिरवते: उत्तर ते पूर्व ते दक्षिण ते पश्चिम.

en.text: A man starts from point P, faces north, and walks 8 km. He then turns to his right and walks 9 km. In which direction is he now from point P?
en.explanation:
Put point P at the origin and treat north as up and east as right.
His first leg of 8 km takes him 8 km north along the north-south axis.
After turning to his right he is facing east, and the second leg of 9 km moves him along the other axis.
Adding the two legs, he ends up 8 km to the north and 9 km to the east of P.
When a point lies both to the north and to the east, its direction is north-east.
The question asks where HE is relative to P, not where P is relative to him — those two are exact opposites, and mixing them up is the classic error.

mr.text: एक माणूस प या ठिकाणाहून उत्तर दिशेला तोंड करून 8 किमी चालतो. नंतर तो आपल्या उजव्या बाजूला वळून 9 किमी चालतो. तर आता तो प या ठिकाणापासून कोणत्या दिशेला आहे?
mr.explanation:
प हे ठिकाण आरंभबिंदू धरा आणि उत्तर वर, पूर्व उजवीकडे असे मानून आकृती काढा.
पहिल्या 8 किमीच्या टप्प्यात तो उत्तर दिशेने 8 किमी जातो.
उजवीकडे वळल्यानंतर दुसऱ्या 9 किमीच्या टप्प्यात तो दुसऱ्या अक्षावर सरकतो.
दोन्ही टप्पे मिळून तो प पासून 8 किमी उत्तरेला व 9 किमी पूर्वेला पोहोचतो.
एखादा बिंदू उत्तरेला व पूर्वेला अशा दोन्ही बाजूंना असेल, तेव्हा त्याची दिशा ईशान्य असते.
प्रश्नात तो प च्या सापेक्ष कोठे आहे असे विचारले आहे, प तो कोठे आहे असे नाही — या दोन दिशा नेमक्या विरुद्ध असतात आणि त्यांची गल्लत होणे ही नेहमीची चूक आहे.

en.text: A man starts from point P, faces west, and walks 13 km. He then turns to his right and walks 12 km. He then turns to his right and walks 4 km. How far, in km, is he now from point P in a straight line?
en.explanation:
Track the two directions separately rather than trying to picture the whole path at once.
He first walks 13 km, then after two right turns the last leg of 4 km takes him back along the same axis, so his net travel on that axis is 13 − 4 = 9 km.
On the other axis he has moved 12 km, and nothing cancels it.
So he is 9 km away in one direction and 12 km in a perpendicular direction — the straight-line distance is the hypotenuse of a right triangle.
Distance = √(9² + 12²) = √(81 + 144) = √225 = 15 km.
The total distance WALKED is 29 km, but the question asks for the straight-line gap, which is always smaller.

en.text: A man starts from point P, faces north, and walks 12 km. He then turns to his right and walks 12 km. He then turns to his right and walks 3 km. How far, in km, is he now from point P in a straight line?
en.explanation:
Track the two directions separately rather than trying to picture the whole path at once.
He first walks 12 km, then after two right turns the last leg of 3 km takes him back along the same axis, so his net travel on that axis is 12 − 3 = 9 km.
On the other axis he has moved 12 km, and nothing cancels it.
So he is 9 km away in one direction and 12 km in a perpendicular direction — the straight-line distance is the hypotenuse of a right triangle.
Distance = √(9² + 12²) = √(81 + 144) = √225 = 15 km.
The total distance WALKED is 27 km, but the question asks for the straight-line gap, which is always smaller.

en.text: A man starts from point P, faces south, and walks 6 km. He then turns to his right and walks 4 km. He then turns to his right and walks 3 km. How far, in km, is he now from point P in a straight line?

Track the two directions separately rather than trying to picture the whole path at once.

Put point P at the origin and treat north as up and east as right.
His first leg of 8 km takes him 8 km south along the north-south axis.
After turning to his left he is facing east, and the second leg of 3 km moves him along the other axis.
Adding the two legs, he ends up 8 km to the south and 3 km to the east of P.
When a point lies both to the south and to the east, its direction is south-east.
The question asks where HE is relative to P, not where P is relative to him — those two are exact opposites, and mixing them up is the classic error.

mr.text: एक माणूस प या ठिकाणाहून दक्षिण दिशेला तोंड करून 8 किमी चालतो. नंतर तो आपल्या डाव्या बाजूला वळून 3 किमी चालतो. तर आता तो प या ठिकाणापासून कोणत्या दिशेला आहे?
mr.explanation:
प हे ठिकाण आरंभबिंदू धरा आणि उत्तर वर, पूर्व उजवीकडे असे मानून आकृती काढा.
पहिल्या 8 किमीच्या टप्प्यात तो दक्षिण दिशेने 8 किमी जातो.
डावीकडे वळल्यानंतर दुसऱ्या 3 किमीच्या टप्प्यात तो दुसऱ्या अक्षावर सरकतो.
दोन्ही टप्पे मिळून तो प पासून 8 किमी दक्षिणेला व 3 किमी पूर्वेला पोहोचतो.
एखादा बिंदू दक्षिणेला व पूर्वेला अशा दोन्ही बाजूंना असेल, तेव्हा त्याची दिशा आग्नेय असते.
प्रश्नात तो प च्या सापेक्ष कोठे आहे असे विचारले आहे, प तो कोठे आहे असे नाही — या दोन दिशा नेमक्या विरुद्ध असतात आणि त्यांची गल्लत होणे ही नेहमीची चूक आहे.

en.text: A man starts from point P, faces east, and walks 5 km. He then turns to his right and walks 4 km. He then turns to his right and walks 2 km. How far, in km, is he now from point P in a straight line?
en.explanation:
Track the two directions separately rather than trying to picture the whole path at once.
He first walks 5 km, then after two right turns the last leg of 2 km takes him back along the same axis, so his net travel on that axis is 5 − 2 = 3 km.
On the other axis he has moved 4 km, and nothing cancels it.
So he is 3 km away in one direction and 4 km in a perpendicular direction — the straight-line distance is the hypotenuse of a right triangle.
Distance = √(3² + 4²) = √(9 + 16) = √25 = 5 km.
The total distance WALKED is 11 km, but the question asks for the straight-line gap, which is always smaller.

mr.text: एक माणूस प या ठिकाणाहून पूर्व दिशेला तोंड करून 5 किमी चालतो. नंतर तो आपल्या उजव्या बाजूला वळून 4 किमी चालतो. नंतर तो आपल्या उजव्या बाजूला वळून 2 किमी चालतो. तर आता तो प या ठिकाणापासून सरळ रेषेत किती किमी अंतरावर आहे?

तो प्रथम 5 किमी चालतो, नंतर दोन उजव्या वळणांनंतरचा 2 किमीचा शेवटचा टप्पा त्याला त्याच अक्षावर मागे आणतो, म्हणून त्या अक्षावरील निव्वळ प्रवास 5 − 2 = 3 किमी.
दुसऱ्या अक्षावर तो 4 किमी सरकला असून ते कशानेही रद्द होत नाही.
म्हणजे तो एका दिशेने 3 किमी व त्याला लंब दिशेने 4 किमी अंतरावर आहे — सरळ रेषेतील अंतर म्हणजे काटकोन त्रिकोणाचा कर्ण.

en.text: A man starts from point P, faces north, and walks 5 km. He then turns to his left and walks 3 km. He then turns to his right and walks 6 km. He then turns to his left and walks 4 km. In which direction is he facing now?
en.explanation:
The distances are irrelevant here — only the turns change the direction he faces.
Start the compass at north.
Turning to his left from north makes him face west.
Turning to his right from west makes him face north.
Turning to his left from north makes him face west.
So he is finally facing west.
Keep in mind that left and right are from the WALKER's point of view, so a right turn always moves the compass one quarter clockwise: north to east to south to west.

उत्तर कडून डावीकडे वळल्यावर तोंड पश्चिम दिशेला होते.
पश्चिम कडून उजवीकडे वळल्यावर तोंड उत्तर दिशेला होते.
उत्तर कडून डावीकडे वळल्यावर तोंड पश्चिम दिशेला होते.
म्हणून शेवटी त्याचे तोंड पश्चिम दिशेला आहे.
डावे-उजवे हे चालणाऱ्याच्या दृष्टिकोनातून असते हे लक्षात ठेवा, म्हणून उजवे वळण होकायंत्र नेहमी एक चतुर्थांश घड्याळाच्या दिशेने फिरवते: उत्तर ते पूर्व ते दक्षिण ते पश्चिम.

संपूर्ण मार्ग एकदम डोळ्यासमोर आणण्यापेक्षा दोन्ही दिशा स्वतंत्रपणे मोजा.
तो प्रथम 11 किमी चालतो, नंतर दोन उजव्या वळणांनंतरचा 5 किमीचा शेवटचा टप्पा त्याला त्याच अक्षावर मागे आणतो, म्हणून त्या अक्षावरील निव्वळ प्रवास 11 − 5 = 6 किमी.
दुसऱ्या अक्षावर तो 8 किमी सरकला असून ते कशानेही रद्द होत नाही.
म्हणजे तो एका दिशेने 6 किमी व त्याला लंब दिशेने 8 किमी अंतरावर आहे — सरळ रेषेतील अंतर म्हणजे काटकोन त्रिकोणाचा कर्ण.
अंतर = √(6² + 8²) = √(36 + 64) = √100 = 10 किमी.
प्रत्यक्ष चाललेले एकूण अंतर 24 किमी आहे, पण प्रश्नात सरळ रेषेतील अंतर विचारले असून ते नेहमी कमीच असते.

en.text: A man starts from point P, faces south, and walks 6 km. He then turns to his left and walks 5 km. In which direction is he now from point P?
en.explanation:
Put point P at the origin and treat north as up and east as right.
His first leg of 6 km takes him 6 km south along the north-south axis.
After turning to his left he is facing east, and the second leg of 5 km moves him along the other axis.
Adding the two legs, he ends up 6 km to the south and 5 km to the east of P.
When a point lies both to the south and to the east, its direction is south-east.
The question asks where HE is relative to P, not where P is relative to him — those two are exact opposites, and mixing them up is the classic error.

mr.text: एक माणूस प या ठिकाणाहून दक्षिण दिशेला तोंड करून 6 किमी चालतो. नंतर तो आपल्या डाव्या बाजूला वळून 5 किमी चालतो. तर आता तो प या ठिकाणापासून कोणत्या दिशेला आहे?
mr.explanation:
प हे ठिकाण आरंभबिंदू धरा आणि उत्तर वर, पूर्व उजवीकडे असे मानून आकृती काढा.
पहिल्या 6 किमीच्या टप्प्यात तो दक्षिण दिशेने 6 किमी जातो.
डावीकडे वळल्यानंतर दुसऱ्या 5 किमीच्या टप्प्यात तो दुसऱ्या अक्षावर सरकतो.
दोन्ही टप्पे मिळून तो प पासून 6 किमी दक्षिणेला व 5 किमी पूर्वेला पोहोचतो.
एखादा बिंदू दक्षिणेला व पूर्वेला अशा दोन्ही बाजूंना असेल, तेव्हा त्याची दिशा आग्नेय असते.
प्रश्नात तो प च्या सापेक्ष कोठे आहे असे विचारले आहे, प तो कोठे आहे असे नाही — या दोन दिशा नेमक्या विरुद्ध असतात आणि त्यांची गल्लत होणे ही नेहमीची चूक आहे.

en.text: A man starts from point P, faces east, and walks 16 km. He then turns to his right and walks 16 km. He then turns to his right and walks 4 km. How far, in km, is he now from point P in a straight line?
en.explanation:
Track the two directions separately rather than trying to picture the whole path at once.
He first walks 16 km, then after two right turns the last leg of 4 km takes him back along the same axis, so his net travel on that axis is 16 − 4 = 12 km.
On the other axis he has moved 16 km, and nothing cancels it.
So he is 12 km away in one direction and 16 km in a perpendicular direction — the straight-line distance is the hypotenuse of a right triangle.
Distance = √(12² + 16²) = √(144 + 256) = √400 = 20 km.
The total distance WALKED is 36 km, but the question asks for the straight-line gap, which is always smaller.

en.text: In a row of students, Rahul is 7th from the left end and 20th from the right end. How many students are there in the row?
en.explanation:
Being 7th from the left means there are 6 students to his left.
Being 20th from the right means there are 19 students to his right.
The row is everyone on his left, plus Rahul himself, plus everyone on his right:
Total = 6 + 1 + 19 = 26.
The usual shortcut is Total = (position from left) + (position from right) − 1, and the −1 is there because Rahul gets counted from both ends.
Simply adding the two positions gives 27, which counts him twice.

mr.text: एका रांगेत राहुल डाव्या टोकाकडून 7 वा आणि उजव्या टोकाकडून 20 वा आहे. तर रांगेत एकूण किती विद्यार्थी आहेत?
mr.explanation:
डावीकडून 7 वा असणे म्हणजे त्याच्या डावीकडे 6 विद्यार्थी आहेत.
उजवीकडून 20 वा असणे म्हणजे त्याच्या उजवीकडे 19 विद्यार्थी आहेत.
संपूर्ण रांग = डावीकडचे सर्व + स्वतः राहुल + उजवीकडचे सर्व:
एकूण = 6 + 1 + 19 = 26.
नेहमीचे सूत्र म्हणजे एकूण = (डावीकडून स्थान) + (उजवीकडून स्थान) − 1, आणि −1 अशासाठी की राहुल दोन्ही टोकांकडून मोजला जातो.
दोन्ही स्थाने नुसती मिळवल्यास 27 येते, ज्यात तो दोनदा मोजला जातो.

en.text: In a row of 25 students, Sita is 21th from the left end. What is her position from the right end?
en.explanation:
Being 21th from the left means 21 students have been counted up to and including Sita.
That leaves 25 − 21 = 4 students to her right.
Counting from the right end, those 4 students come first and Sita is the very next one.
So her position from the right = 4 + 1 = 5.
The formula is (position from right) = Total − (position from left) + 1. Stopping at 4 forgets to count Sita herself, and that off-by-one is what the question is testing.

mr.text: 25 विद्यार्थ्यांच्या रांगेत सीता डाव्या टोकाकडून 21 वी आहे. तर उजव्या टोकाकडून तिचे स्थान कितवे?
mr.explanation:
डावीकडून 21 वी असणे म्हणजे सीतेसह 21 विद्यार्थी मोजून झाले आहेत.
म्हणजे तिच्या उजवीकडे 25 − 21 = 4 विद्यार्थी उरतात.
उजव्या टोकाकडून मोजायला सुरुवात केल्यास ते 4 विद्यार्थी आधी येतात आणि लगेच सीता येते.
म्हणून उजवीकडून तिचे स्थान = 4 + 1 = 5.
सूत्र: (उजवीकडून स्थान) = एकूण − (डावीकडून स्थान) + 1. 4 वर थांबल्यास स्वतः सीता मोजायची राहून जाते, आणि हीच एका अंकाची चूक प्रश्नात तपासली जाते.

en.text: In a row of students, Karan is 8th from the left end and Meena is 14th from the right end. They interchange their positions, and Karan then becomes 27th from the left end. How many students are there in the row?
en.explanation:
The key idea is that swapping does not move anybody else — Karan simply steps into the exact spot Meena was standing in.
So Meena's original position from the left must have been 27.
We also know Meena was 14th from the right.
Applying the standard rule to Meena: Total = (position from left) + (position from right) − 1.
Total = 27 + 14 − 1 = 40.
Karan's original position of 8th is not needed at all — it is there to see whether you have understood which person the two facts now describe.

mr.text: एका रांगेत करण डाव्या टोकाकडून 8 वा आहे आणि मीना उजव्या टोकाकडून 14 वी आहे. दोघांनी आपापल्या जागा बदलल्यानंतर करण डाव्या टोकाकडून 27 वा होतो. तर रांगेत एकूण किती विद्यार्थी आहेत?
mr.explanation:
मुख्य मुद्दा असा की जागा बदलल्याने इतर कोणीही हलत नाही — करण नेमका मीना उभी होती त्याच जागी जातो.
म्हणून मीनाचे मूळ स्थान डावीकडून 27 वे असले पाहिजे.

एकूण = 27 + 14 − 1 = 40.
करणचे मूळ 8 वे स्थान येथे मुळीच लागत नाही — आता ही दोन्ही माहिती कोणत्या व्यक्तीची आहे हे समजले का, हे तपासण्यासाठीच ते दिले आहे.

डावीकडून 9 वा असणे म्हणजे त्याच्या डावीकडे 8 विद्यार्थी आहेत.
उजवीकडून 24 वा असणे म्हणजे त्याच्या उजवीकडे 23 विद्यार्थी आहेत.
संपूर्ण रांग = डावीकडचे सर्व + स्वतः राहुल + उजवीकडचे सर्व:
एकूण = 8 + 1 + 23 = 32.
नेहमीचे सूत्र म्हणजे एकूण = (डावीकडून स्थान) + (उजवीकडून स्थान) − 1, आणि −1 अशासाठी की राहुल दोन्ही टोकांकडून मोजला जातो.
दोन्ही स्थाने नुसती मिळवल्यास 33 येते, ज्यात तो दोनदा मोजला जातो.

en.text: In a row of 25 students, Sita is 14th from the left end. What is her position from the right end?
en.explanation:
Being 14th from the left means 14 students have been counted up to and including Sita.
That leaves 25 − 14 = 11 students to her right.
Counting from the right end, those 11 students come first and Sita is the very next one.
So her position from the right = 11 + 1 = 12.
The formula is (position from right) = Total − (position from left) + 1. Stopping at 11 forgets to count Sita herself, and that off-by-one is what the question is testing.

mr.text: 25 विद्यार्थ्यांच्या रांगेत सीता डाव्या टोकाकडून 14 वी आहे. तर उजव्या टोकाकडून तिचे स्थान कितवे?
mr.explanation:
डावीकडून 14 वी असणे म्हणजे सीतेसह 14 विद्यार्थी मोजून झाले आहेत.
म्हणजे तिच्या उजवीकडे 25 − 14 = 11 विद्यार्थी उरतात.

म्हणून उजवीकडून तिचे स्थान = 11 + 1 = 12.

en.text: In a row of students, Karan is 8th from the left end and Meena is 16th from the right end. They interchange their positions, and Karan then becomes 15th from the left end. How many students are there in the row?

So Meena's original position from the left must have been 15.
We also know Meena was 16th from the right.
Applying the standard rule to Meena: Total = (position from left) + (position from right) − 1.

करणचे मूळ 8 वे स्थान येथे मुळीच लागत नाही — आता ही दोन्ही माहिती कोणत्या व्यक्तीची आहे हे समजले का, हे तपासण्यासाठीच ते दिले आहे.

en.text: What is the angle, in degrees, between the hour hand and the minute hand of a clock at 7:50?
en.explanation:
Measure both hands from the 12 mark and then subtract — never try to eyeball it.
The minute hand covers the full 360° in 60 minutes, so it moves 6° per minute. At 50 minutes it is at 50 × 6 = 300° from 12.
The hour hand covers 360° in 12 hours, so it moves 30° per hour AND an extra 0.5° per minute. This half-degree drift is the step almost everyone forgets.
At 7:50 the hour hand is at 7 × 30 + 50 × 0.5 = 210 + 25 = 235° from 12.
Difference = |235 − 300| = 65°.
A clock angle is always reported as the smaller of the two arcs, so the answer is 65°.

mr.text: घड्याळात 7:50 वाजता तास काटा व मिनिट काटा यांच्यातील कोन किती अंश असेल?
mr.explanation:
